snippet.title: HOPETOWN - Word Travels Fast | Hopetown Official Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Designed by some of the team behind the groundbreaking Disco Elysium, Hopetown is a narrative-first RPG with seismic conversations where your choices matter. Gather evidence, interview characters, and unravel a mining mystery. Harvest truth or sell lies - whatever it takes to make the front page.

Pre-order a discounted early copy of the game on Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/longduegames/hopetown. 
Limited ‘Newsflash’ edition available till 29 May only. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481610/Hopetown/ 

Visit our website to subscribe to updates and join our Discord: www.hopetowngame.com 

Our latest gameplay teaser dives into the history of the town of New Greenwich - set in a world still reeling from a cataclysmic solar flare that caused The Hush - a total reset of global communications and news media, elevating the career of journalist to that of prestigious ‘flashwriter’. Roleplay as a flashwriter and decide: will your words rule with an iron fist, or spark a revolution that brings the world to its knees? Gather evidence, interview characters, and choose how to publish articles that change the game world and story. The people want The Truth - a job usually reserved for the best, but you’ll do for now. 

#Hopetown #RPG #Indiegames #NarrativeGame #GameplayTeaser
